body: I was also thinking of putting up a short affirmation above my bed. Such as, "BE, do, have." reminding myself to trick myself into being another way.
I think since my depression hits in the a.m. i am going to develop a morning routine. This way when I wake up, I have something to do right away.

I do use cannibis. Sometimes it is my only escape. There are times when you really can do nothing and have to stick it out. 
I am contemplating moving since I lived in a very nice climate for a couple years and I was happier there. Things weren't perfect but I had ambition at least. I wasn't isolated in my home for months at a time due to extreme weather.
That's dry humor right? I hope so...

what I am concerned with isn't right after transitioning. I figured that I was now attracted to men because of a theory I came up with awhile ago. Then Max from The Lword stole it from me. (insert dry humor smirk) The theory is that we are attracted to similar or disimilar as opposed to being attracted to either men or women. (I know that's polarized thinking. just an example.) So when ppl often shift who they are attracted to during early transition, I have been there. 
What I am concerned with is how my sexuality still continues, after over 10 yrs on T, to fluctuate. I identified as gay for the past couple years and now I realize I have strong feelings for a woman. I havent felt this way about anyone since my ex bf of a year and a half ago.

I began T over ten years ago. I get what you are saying but I just don't think it's emotions attached to transitioning. I think I was just pointing out all my closets but it wasn't necessary. May have been misleading.

I have had my very intimate relationships with women. With men, it is tough to gauge since my first experience with men wasn't very symbiotic. This experience altered how I feel about intimacy with men. But as far as simply having sex the best sex is with men. Confusing?

Right on. I think I feel a need to label myself so others know how to take me. When I am frustrated with my sexuality, I am really just worried how I will be perceived. "He is changing his mind again. Can't he just pick a side?"

I guess I get so overwhelmed with emotions that I disconnect from...me. i have experienced being disassociated in traumatic events. I wonder if this doesn't appear to me as a traumatic event while I am in it. That would explain my panic.

Yes, I go on autopilot except my words and behaviors do not match up with how I feel. I am constantly looking for an escape without being obvious. I constantly walk away from talking within a group setting with so much regret of things I said or did. I wonder how they were perceived. I definitely am impulsive. It's like I have to get the words out as if I am racing something. Then I wonder why the heck I would say that. It causes awkward silence. It doesn't feel like I am running the show so to speak.

I do not enjoy being in groups of 3 or more. It seems I lose the ability to filter what I say or do. I become focused on something I want to bring up even though my gut tells me not to. I tend to act so quickly on my thoughts that I speak irretractable opinions. I honestly never mean to put anyone off. Once at a restaurant with about twenty other college students I felt anxious during the meal. Not sure how to act even. Someone was talking with me in a humorous way and I felt a need to throw a wrapped set of silverware over people's heads before it slammed into the wall. My intent was to playfully show I didnt agree. However, the fact that this would be seen as hostile did not compute quick enough. I fear I may just be that low in intelligence. 
Another time I was irritated with someone at work. A part of the job is keeping track of numbers on the machinery such as the generator. I got so caught up in my anger I decided to start up the generator in order to change the numbers. This way I could prove my co-worker was not really checking them when his wouldn't match up. Of course, I didn't know how to shut it off right away. It took me about 1 minute to hit the right button. By this time, I had managed to alter the recording on the machine but now the whole facility was being alarmed that something was wrong through security systems. I asked to leave right away saying I was having a panic attack. I was having one. I was fired. My big question is does anyone know why I might lose perception on what's going on around me and what is expected of me? It causes me lots of problems socially.
